# CORE-TRC-02

**Does the design's type agree with its abstraction?**

| | |
|---|---|
| Lens | [Core architecture lens](core.md) 0.6.0 |
| Area | TRC: Place on the continuum |
| Default severity | major |
| Decided by | A tool, by its rule |
| Reads | `design.type`, `elements.kind` |

## Why it matters

An architecture pattern is conceptual or logical; a reference architecture or a solution design is physical. A design whose boxes do not fit its type is still being written.

## Rule

Derive the abstraction from the kinds of the in-scope elements (actor and external-system excluded): all local-role is conceptual; abb with or without local-role is logical; all sbb, technology, service, store or deployment-node is physical; anything else is mixed. An architecture-pattern must be conceptual or logical; a reference-architecture or solution-design must be physical.
